proof_scope: Finite original HERCULES.EXE boundary probes using synthetic vertices, surface, texture and globals; no whole raster or game execution.

reciprocal_table.independent_formula: R[0]=0; R[i]=floor(2^30/i) for i=1..2047 (Python integer division, checked against all initialized entries).
reciprocal_table.note: Runtime table values are synthetic initialized data, not original-code spans or a canonical data table claim.

assertions.name: original_initializer_all_entries
assertions.observed: all 2048 initialized entries match R[0]=0; floor(2^30/i) for i=1..2047 in each isolated emulator

assertions.name: d60c_dy0_skips_reciprocal
assertions.observed: flat zero-height D60C fixture returns without table reads or writes

assertions.name: d60c_dy2047_uses_last_entry
assertions.observed: two edge lookups use R[2047]=0x80100; this clipped high-Y fixture makes no surface writes

assertions.name: d60c_dy2048_guard
assertions.observed: signed JGE extent guard taken at D6CF before any reciprocal lookup

assertions.name: d60c_zero_width_span_skips_span_lookup
assertions.observed: vertical zero-width fixture can read edge reciprocals but skips DB8E span lookup

assertions.name: d60c_span319_reads_last_screen_width
assertions.observed: one-row width-319 fixture reads R[319] and emits 319 pixels

assertions.name: d60c_span2047_lookup_precedes_crop
assertions.observed: wide fixture reads both row widths before visible output is cropped; 2047 is not rejected by the extent guard

assertions.name: d60c_span2048_extent_guard
assertions.observed: X extent 2048 takes the D6E4 guard before table lookup

assertions.name: c2_dy0_avoids_idiv
assertions.observed: horizontal zero-height fixture returns without IDIV or divide fault

assertions.name: c2_dy2047_signed_idiv
assertions.observed: two signed divisions by 2047 use opposite signed Q16 x deltas

assertions.name: c2_dy2048_guard
assertions.observed: Y extent 2048 takes C3CB guard before IDIV

assertions.name: c2_xspan2047_shift_is_in_range
assertions.observed: X extent 2047 reaches IDIV; its negative SHL-16 dividend remains signed-32 representable

assertions.name: c2_xspan2048_guard
assertions.observed: X extent 2048 takes C3DA guard before IDIV

assertions.name: d60c_q30_2047_edge_steps
assertions.observed: original IMUL then SHRD-30 outputs agree with signed 64-bit products for the dy=2047 pair

assertions.name: d60c_q30_wide_edge_step
assertions.observed: accepted |deltaX|=2047 edge step agrees with explicit signed product and SHRD-30 bit extraction

arithmetic_contract.table_indexing: D60C/CC50/DD70/E680 use an 11-bit masked index at the recorded loads; dynamic D60C probes record address-derived indices and values.
arithmetic_contract.table_edge_step: D60C dynamically records signed 32-bit delta, signed IMUL 64-bit product and SHRD 30 output; independent arithmetic is finite and boundary-specific. CC50/DD70/E680 are statically observed at analogous masked loads only.
arithmetic_contract.C2E0_edge_step: CDQ/IDIV signed division after 32-bit SHL EAX,16; divide events and post-IDIV quotient/remainder are checked for finite accepted inputs.
arithmetic_contract.overflow_scope: No claim about arbitrary wrapping. The accepted X-domain and delta-shift boundary are checked only for listed fixtures; values outside the guard/clamp domain are recorded as rejected paths.

limits: No 2,048-row frame was rasterized: tall cases clip to one scan row and wide cases are at most 319 pixels or exit before the span loop.
D60C, CC50, DD70 and E680 are covered statically; dynamic D60C and C2E0 boundary probes do not establish identical behavior of the four masked-table consumers.
C2E0 source-byte fills are only probed for edge-step boundary behavior; no general constant-fill implementation is inferred.
No GPU, SDL, host callback, gameplay, OS endpoint, asset, canonical source, or Git state was modified.

compaction.change: Original instruction bytes replaced by size/SHA-256; no code embedded.
